subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The manuscript contained a **siglum** to denote a textual variant.

options.text: The editor inserted the siglum before the footnote.
The lab technician cleaned the siglum from the sample slide.
The scholar decoded each siglum used in the Vulgate.
The margin displayed an unknown siglum.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"siglum"** refers to a letter, symbol, or other character used to represent a word, name, or concept, often in manuscripts or scholarly works. (संकेत चिह्न)
 
 
• **Example:** The scholar used a siglum to denote textual variants in the ancient manuscript.
 
 
• The correct word in Option 2 is a homonym of "siglum." It refers to cleaning or removing a foreign object or substance in a completely different context, such as in a laboratory setting. (संदर्भ में भिन्न उपयोग)
 
 
• **Example:** The lab technician cleaned the siglum from the sample slide to ensure accurate results.
 
 
• The term "homonym" refers to a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation as another word but differs in meaning. This is why Option 2 is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "The editor inserted the siglum before the footnote." (संपादक ने फुटनोट से पहले संकेत चिह्न लगाया।) 
 
 
• This sentence uses "siglum" in its original scholarly context as a symbol or abbreviation.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The scholar decoded each siglum used in the Vulgate." (विद्वान ने वल्गेट में प्रयुक्त प्रत्येक संकेत चिह्न को डिकोड किया।)
 
 
• This sentence also uses "siglum" in its original scholarly sense of representing a textual variant or abbreviation.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The margin displayed an unknown siglum." (मार्जिन ने एक अज्ञात संकेत चिह्न दिखाया।)
 
 
• Again, "siglum" refers to a symbol or letter used in manuscripts or scholarly text.
